findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regex Substitution in Compliance Fixes
 * @description usage of re.sub in compliance fixes might be interesting to review for correctness or ReDoS.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/regex-substitution-compliance
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember("sub").getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("%compliance_fixes%")
select call, "Regex substitution in compliance fix."
findings.hypothesis: Complex regexes used in compliance fixes on potentially large response bodies could lead to ReDoS or incorrect data parsing.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Extract Regex Pattern
 * @description Extracts the regex pattern used in substitution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/extract-regex-pattern
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ArgumentNode arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember("sub").getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select call, "Regex pattern: " + arg.getALocalSource().asExpr().(StringLiteral).getText()
